About UsHeadteacher's Welcome
Text
At Purley Oaks we firmly believe that every child will be supported, valued and challenged. We are ambitious for our children and their families and are driven by our moral purpose to ensure that everything we do has a positive impact on the children’s lives. We are determined that our children will take pride in their learning and themselves and that they will strive for excellence.
By working closely together and continuously improving our practice, there is no limit to what can be achieved.
Our ethos is based on five themes. Ethos Award certificates and medals are presented to pupils who demonstrate these qualities at the end of each half term:
Our weekly Pride in Excellence award certificates are presented to pupils who exemplify the skills of being:
Our Ethos Awards and Pride in Excellence Awards underpins everything we do. It is these shared values which unites our Purley Oaks community as we strive for excellence.
We are always delighted to receive visitors, so please do take the time to come and see us.
Mr R J Griffin BA (Hons) PGCE MAHeadteacher

Parent InformationWraparound Care
Text
Breakfast Club
Our breakfast club opens from 7:30am until school starts and it provides children with a secure and happy environment to begin their day. Breakfast club costs £5.00 a day, which includes breakfast and supervision. Please book and pay for places in advance via the My Child at School platform in the Wraparound Care section.
The school also accepts childcare vouchers.
Children are taken to class by a member of the breakfast club team.
After School Club - POPS Kids
Our after school club POPS Kids is run by the school. POPS Kids runs from 3.00pm until 6.30pm and includes supervision and light refreshment. Each session costs £15.00 booked a month in advance and non-refundable or £16.00 booked or cancellable up to 24 hours before. Please book and pay for places in advance via the My Child at School platform in the Wraparound Care section.
The school also accepts childcare vouchers.
A member of POPS Kids will collect your child from the class at the end of the school day.

POPS Kids Information
Holiday Camps
Holiday camps are run on site during the summer holiday, easter break and half-terms by 123 Holiday Club. They offer fun-filled weeks of adventure, creativity and friendship.
